title: ReachPlusLink
description: This plugin is the handshake/opt-in for the ReachPlus mod. This needs to be installed on paper servers to give players the full effect of the ReachPlus mod.
body: This Plugin is the handshake/opt-in system for the ReachPlus mod. This plugin has to be installed in paper servers for players to get the full effect of ReachPlus. Without this installed in the server the mod itself will fall back to client side functionality only.
